candidate.answerReason: Unfolding turns the slant height into the sector radius and the base rim into the sector arc. Its arc length therefore equals the base circumference, as stated in C.

methods.label: Match the cone to its unfolded sector
methods.explanation: After unfolding, the sector's radius is the slant height \(l\), and its arc length is the circumference of the base circle, \(2\pi r\).
methods.levelReason: Matching the cone's surface to a sector uses the Grade 9 unfolding correspondence and elementary sector and circumference knowledge.
